roles.training-feature: enters the model's feature vector for an instrument
roles.directional-evidence: may cast a directional vote in the evidence model
roles.decision-context: qualifies or explains a decision; may never set a direction
roles.integrity-veto: may withhold a decision or exclude a row; may never create or reverse one
roles.historical-prior: base rates over past outcomes; informs confidence, not direction
roles.evaluation-stratification: splits measured results for reporting; never a model input
roles.research-only: informs research and documentation; never reaches the decision engine
roles.documented-exclusion: no permitted source serves it; the gap itself is the artifact

rule: every layer names a destination and a consumer; the consumer must resolve on disk, and only an instrument-level layer may cast a directional vote

layers.pointInTime: closes <= asOf; the as-of close is excluded from every forward window
layers.whenAbsent: no price, no row: the instrument is ineligible, never defaulted

layers.pointInTime: daily series with its own date; used only to date and bound an episode
layers.whenAbsent: an episode without a benchmark is reported as uncovered, not assumed calm

layers.pointInTime: an action's date must precede the window it invalidates
layers.whenAbsent: unknown action: the row keeps its flag and the consumer excludes it explicitly

layers.pointInTime: joined on observation_date + publicationLagDays, never on observation date alone
layers.whenAbsent: no macro reading: no veto, and no neutral vote invented in its place

layers.pointInTime: FRED observation dates; same publication-lag rule as macro
layers.whenAbsent: absent: the context line is omitted rather than filled with a stale level

layers.pointInTime: 2005-2012; entirely before the 2018 dataset, so it can only inform research
layers.whenAbsent: absent: the 2008 regime is reported as out of training range
the licence-limited ICE series is evidenced by a dated probe, not guessed

layers.pointInTime: closes <= asOf, as any other instrument
registry read date recorded; a delisting is known only from its filing date
layers.whenAbsent: unknown lifecycle: the instrument stays in the universe and the gap is recorded

layers.pointInTime: n/a: no permitted source serves it
layers.whenAbsent: the probe record is the artifact; survivorship stays a measured lower bound
the archive floor is established by probe, not assumed

layers.pointInTime: an event may only inform a decision whose timestamp follows its publication
layers.whenAbsent: no event: `eventInDays` is null, which is not the same as 'no event due'

layers.pointInTime: publication time strictly before the decision timestamp
layers.whenAbsent: no press record: the event stands on its own disposition

layers.pointInTime: published < decision; pruned at 70 days, so never a historical corpus
layers.whenAbsent: coverage 'unavailable' is never converted into a neutral tone

layers.pointInTime: before-state strictly before the event; forward windows strictly after
layers.whenAbsent: an event without a reaction window is dropped, not zero-filled

layers.pointInTime: literature has no bearing on a decision timestamp
layers.whenAbsent: an untestable principle is recorded as untestable

layers.pointInTime: episode windows are known only in hindsight, so they may never enter a predictor
layers.whenAbsent: a session outside every episode is reported as 'none', not as calm

layers.pointInTime: assembled from point-in-time features and mature outcomes only
layers.whenAbsent: immature rows are excluded, never labelled FLAT
